content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Specialty cellulose and pharmaceutical ingredients for formulators, not commodity ethylene production sold to petrochemical buyers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Roofing, insulation and industrial components for construction and vehicles, a different product set entirely."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mines and processes salt and fertilizer from brine and ore, not ethylene made from purchased hydrocarbon feedstock."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC components and industrial valves, unrelated to ethylene or petrochemical production."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Nitrogen fertilizers and ammonia from natural gas sold to farmers, a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Specialty polymers, additives and fibers for many manufacturers, with a different product mix and customer set."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Catalysts and sulfuric acid regeneration services for refiners, a service-led model rather than ethylene production."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Single-plant fuel ethanol from corn sold to fuel blenders, a different feedstock, product and customer set."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mines potash and salt in New Mexico and Utah for fertilizer and deicing, not chemical ethylene production."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Nitrogen chemicals for mining and agriculture plus HVAC heat pumps, not ethylene or olefin production."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Chlor-alkali and epoxy chemicals plus ammunition sold to retail and government, not ethylene for a parent or plastics buyers."}]}
